nodes.name: Daily Trigger 09:13 UTC
nodes.notes: Stage 1 — Trigger. Offset off the hour so it does not collide with the sentiment scrape at 09:07.

nodes.name: Fetch Channel
nodes.notes: Stage 2 — Input acquisition. 1 quota unit. Credential supplies ?key= so it never appears in the workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Fetch Uploads Playlist
nodes.notes: Stage 2 cont. 1 unit per page. Paginates the full uploads playlist.

nodes.name: Batch Video IDs
nodes.notes: Stage 4 — Business Logic. Batches of 50 keep videos.list at 1 unit per call.

nodes.name: Fetch Video Stats
nodes.notes: Stage 2 cont. The authoritative numbers. Never scrape these from the page.

nodes.name: Normalize + Validate
nodes.notes: Stages 5 & 6 — Data Normalization and Result Validation. Enforces the reconciliation invariant.

nodes.name: Commit to GitHub
nodes.notes: Stages 7 & 10 — Audit trail and Completion. Same-path write is idempotent: a re-run overwrites the day, never appends.

nodes.name: Error Branch
nodes.notes: Stages 8 & 9 — Error Branch and Fallback. Classifies the failure and names the manual recovery path.

_notes.standard: Follows the ten-stage layout in agency-agents/automation-governance-architect.md: Trigger, Input Validation, Data Normalization, Business Logic, External Actions, Result Validation, Logging/Audit, Error Branch, Fallback/Recovery, Completion.
_notes.credentials: Two, both configured in the n8n GUI and never in this file. (1) 'YouTube Data API Key' as a Query Auth credential with name=key, value=<your key>. (2) 'GitHub API' - reuse the existing repo-scoped credential from the Fellow workflow. Credential IDs are placeholders; reconnect both after import.
_notes.quota: A full pull is roughly 2 + ceil(videos/50) units against a 10,000/day free allowance - about 4 units for this channel. search.list is deliberately unused; it costs 100 units for the same result.
_notes.idempotency: Writing to the same dated path overwrites. Re-running mid-day updates the day rather than duplicating it.
_notes.reAudit: Per the governance agent's re-audit triggers, revisit when: the YouTube API version or quota changes, the error rate rises, video volume grows enough to change the batch count, or repeated manual fixes appear.
_notes.owner: Data Analytics Reporter owns what is measured. Automation Governance Architect owns this workflow's standard. YouTube Analyst owns the channel.
